subject: Handoff: Hearthwell Health - Implementation kickoff & risk owners
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Hearthwell Health - Implementation kickoff & risk owners

Hi Dylan —

Quick handoff for Hearthwell (DL-2028-0765). They signed the SOW yesterday; committed to go-live for Q4. High-level context below and explicit asks for CS/Implementation: 

Deal snapshot
- ARR: $220k annual commit (first-year ramp)
- Initial scope: hosted inference endpoint (text generation), single-region (us-west-2), dev/test + prod environments
- Start date target: Sept 4 (customer prefers early Sept kickoff)

Key contacts (external)
- Tom Nguyen (Director of AI) — primary technical contact — tnguyen@hearthwell.com
- Sara Patel (PM, Clinical Ops) — product/clinical owner — sara.patel@hearthwell.com
- IT Ops mailbox — network and firewall coordination

Known risks / blockers
1) Egress & network: They require a dedicated outbound IP and specific firewall rules (see attached network_requirements.xlsx).
2) Data retention & logs: Need a statement that audit logs will be available for 90 days; security questionnaire in progress.
3) Integration: They plan to stream logs into Splunk via our webhook — SE involvement required.

Attachments: Hearthwell_SOW_v1.pdf (signed copy), network_requirements.xlsx, kickoff-agenda-draft.odt

Asks for CS/Implementation
- Can we schedule a 90-min kickoff the week of Sept 4? (customer prefers mornings PT)
- Marissa: please own the customer success plan and the SLA conversation.
- Dev: can you scope the Splunk webhook + recommended batching strategy?

Marissa will be engaged for renewal/health. Karthik will be on standby for contract questions.

Thanks — feel free to loop anyone else in.

—Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks Aditya — I got this.

Quick notes after a first pass:
- I'll take primary owner for the kickoff and implementation timeline.
- Marissa, will you confirm success metrics you want tracked in the first 90 days (adoption + latency targets)?
- Dev, can you review the Splunk webhook ask and give an initial effort estimate by EOD Monday 8/13?

I'll draft a kickoff agenda and proposed dates and share with Tom/Sara early next week.

Dylan

dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1 206-555-0199

Hi Dylan / Marissa —

Thanks for the summary, Aditya. Sept 4 works for us for a kickoff. Prefer mornings PT (9am–11am PT).

A couple of clarifications from our side: 
- For the network items, IT Ops will want the exact outbound IP and port list before the kickoff; is that something your infra team can provide as a stub?
- For the Splunk integration, we want to confirm whether logs will include the full prompt/response or only metadata (privacy question from compliance).

I've attached our standard internal onboarding checklist (not included in attachments above) — happy to share if useful.

Quick internal note — from a product/onboarding-risk perspective: 
- Recommend we request a short security attestation form from Hearthwell before kickoff confirming data classification and logging expectations. I can draft a one-page attestation.
- If they insist on storing full prompts in Splunk, we should flag this to Security; might require redaction options or ensure Splunk retention aligns with their PHI policy.

Dev — ping me after you review the webhook scope; I can escalate to infra for a dedicated outbound IP if needed (cost implications need to be surfaced).

Karthik

Quick update — I reviewed the Splunk webhook ask and the attached network_requirements.xlsx. Initial estimate: 2.5 engineer-days to implement the webhook, test in staging, and produce the integration design doc. 

Notes: 
- We can provide a temporary list of outbound IPs by 8/21 for firewall rules; for a dedicated static egress IP we'll need infra coordination and potentially an added monthly fee (will surface if they require it).
- For logs: default is metadata-only (event, timestamp, request id). If Heartwell needs full prompt/response, we'll add a configurable redact/opt-in flag and route it through a secure consumer with shortened retention. That will add ~1 day to the effort.

I'll start a draft integration doc in Confluence and link it to the kickoff invite.

—Dev
